name: nice!nano v2
description: The wireless-keyboard standard: nRF52840 in a Pro Micro footprint with USB-C, LiPo charger, UF2 bootloader and very low idle current; drop-in for Pro Micro boards (ZMK/QMK).
notes: Pro Micro pin-compatible but 3.3 V logic (not 5 V tolerant). Adafruit UF2 bootloader: double-tap reset to mount as a drive.

P0.13 on the VCC pin switches the 3.3 V rail for external peripherals; P0.04 reads battery voltage and cannot be used otherwise. Charger supports 4.2 V LiPo via solder pads (100/500 mA); no connector.
About $25 at nicekeyboards.com (price not shown on the product page, verify). Many cheaper 'SuperMini nRF52840' clones exist.
No header data: pin order not verified from an official drawing.
